name: Framing column beside a grid of instances
useWhen: One principle has to be stated once and then shown through four to six named instances, and the principle deserves more room than any single instance.
$useWhenNote: Written by hand. Generated from family+form it would read 'six columns, dot headers', which is construction, not the problem it solves.

focal.note: Deliberately low. Nothing on this slide out-shouts the headline; the intro leads by colour and position, not size.

replacesNote: columns-v1 gives three equal spacious columns and leaves the lower half of the canvas empty. This carries nearly twice the content and reaches y~900. Do not retire columns-v1 until this has been through a real deck.

deviations.why: Uses --m-text (56px), the token added for exactly this: the playbook sets 40px margins for structure, the bank sets running copy at x=57.

contractGapsClosed: .headline--lg (64px) — the measured headline tier. The 54px default descends from the old x1.5 factor.
